threshold_rule: Use calibrated posterior probability >= 0.5, then greedily retain a one-to-one compatible link set ordered by decreasing probability and stable observation IDs.
error_auprc_definition: Rank association errors with score 1 - correct-link confidence and label 1 - true_link.
reproduction_policy: After publication, exact replay is allowed only to verify the published artifact; it cannot create a second decision attempt.
